invariants.rationale: The method always returns HoodieListData.lazy(records), which should not be null even if records is null or empty.
The return value is constructed via HoodieListData.lazy(), so it will always be an instance of HoodieListData.
If HoodieListData.lazy preserves all elements from records, the result's count matches records' size.
By the time the result is returned, records must have been provided (cannot be null according to typical function contracts and List semantic expectations).
By return type and value construction, result will be a subtype of HoodieData.
